changes.to: Slips: the 4–6 keys touching each key (staggered rows), a letter too many (not the last), two letters swapped, a letter left out (inputs ≤ 10 letters, words only); sentences for inputs ≤ 16 letters and only at ≤ 25 cost per letter. A slip never outranks a good reading as typed (≤ 25 per letter), costs +20 in another language than the best typed reading, does not take its kind's reserved place, and only one goes in the bar when the letters give words. Cost on the Mac: ~14 ms per keystroke typical (was 11), 19 ms on a 26-letter input (was 8).
